chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa' from Aban from Ibn Abi Ya'fur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:

Regarding a woman who died before she had been slept with, what is for her from the dower, and how is her inheritance? So he said: If he had obligated a dower for her, then for her is half the dower, and he inherits her; and if he had not obligated a dower for her, then there is no dower for her.

And he said regarding a man who died before he had slept with his wife: If he had obligated a dower for her, then for her is half the dower, and she inherits him; and if he had not obligated a dower for her, then there is no dower for her.

key_terms.صَدَاقاً: Dower/Mahr specified in the marriage contract

ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance and dower rights of a wife who dies before consummation of marriage in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the jurisprudential status of the 'half-dower' (nصف الصداق) and inheritance rights in cases of death prior to consummation, a key distinction in Shia fiqh from the Sunni view which often grants full dower. It establishes that the marital bond is sufficient for inheritance even without physical union, provided the contract was valid and a dower was stipulated. This ruling underscores the principle that the wife's right to half the dower is contingent upon the existence of a specified amount, reflecting the contractual nature of the marriage in Shia law.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Ibn Abu Yafour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding a wife who died before she had been slept with, what is for her from the dower, and how is her inheritance to be? So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If the dower had been obligated for her, so for her is half the dower, and he would inherit her; and if a dower was not obligated for her, so there is no dower for her’.

And he<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a man who died before he had slept with his wife. He<sup>asws</sup> said; ‘If a dower had been obligated for her, so for her is half, and she would inherit him; and if a dower had not been obligated for her, so there is no dower for her’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from ibn abu Ya‘fur who has said the following: “About the case of a woman who dies before his going to bed with her, about her mahr (dower) and her inheritance, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘If mahr (dower) is set for her, she deserves one-half of it and he inherits her legacy. If mahr (dower) is not set then mahr (dower) is not payable to her.’

About the case of a man who dies before going to bed with his wife, he (the Imam) said, ‘If he has set mahr (dower) for her she deserves one-half of it and she inherits him, but if mahr (dower) is not set she then does not have the right to demand any mahr (dower).”’
